seam_check.definition: every die-level net between two hard slots (tile<->tile, tile<->hub, element<->relay) is a SEAM
structure: registered both sides (pin flop in, flop out; macro outputs captured with no logic)
<= 504 um of wire per stage (relays at discrete sites; last segment <= ~100 um into an unregistered input)
no seam net fanout > 64 without replication
tools: tools/qwen_kv_die/die_audit.py (structure: hops_over_reach, pin overlaps, region extents)
tools/budgets/clock_plan.py emit/record (die clock to every slot clock entry: intra/inter skew policy, 0 violations)
tools/qwen_kv_die/chain/die_chain.sh (case -> PDN check_power_grid -> GRT -> STA on slot libs with measured clock arrivals) + pad_chain.sh (rule-H1 hold pads)
per-REGION die-top detailed route (DRT) with slots as fixed macros, relays/hubs as the only logic: to be added (AMENDMENT 2)
